candidate.answerReason: Leah has 7 pennies and 6 nickels, worth 7+6·5=37 cents.

methods.label: Add the extra nickel temporarily
methods.explanation:
Adding one nickel would give Leah \(13+1=14\) coins, with equal numbers of pennies and nickels. Each kind would therefore have \(14\div2=7\) coins.

Removing that extra nickel leaves 7 pennies and 6 nickels. Since a penny is worth 1 cent and a nickel is worth 5 cents, the actual value is
\[
7\cdot1+6\cdot5=37\text{ cents}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{37}\) cents, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
